anomalousPeriodsMergeSpan.description:
After a list of anomalous periods are detected, if two periods are separated by less than `anomalousMergeSpan` time,
the two periods will be merged - the period between them is also masked. If set to null duration `"0h"`, this
transformation is not applied.

masksToUse.description:
Allows users to specify a list of masks that they want to apply to the input features data before computing the anomalous
periods in {@link AlgorithmicallyComputedTrainingMaskTechnique#doPrepareMask}
All masks in {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationMaskCategory} can be specified, except for `mask_AlgorithmicallyComputed`

Note that if the {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationSpec#approach} is `sequential`, then the masks specified here
must be specified before the `mask_AlgorithmicallyComputed` mask. If not specified before `mask_AlgorithmicallyComputed`,
then these masks will not be applied to the input features data.

title:
Abstract type that users can extend and implement their own technique to compute anomalous periods within the
training data. A user can extend and implement the {@link doPrepareMask} method to mask out data corresponding
to anomalous periods.

Here is a simple example to explain how the pipe can be extended and implemented. This example simply masks all data
before February 2023.

type MyCustomMaskingTechnique mixes AlgorithmicallyComputedTrainingMaskTechnique {

doPrepareMask: ~ py-sklearn

}

Python Implementation:
```python
def doPrepareMask(this, featuresData, masks):
  from datetime import datetime
  features_data = featuresData.toPandas()
  features_data['Mask'] = [int(i < datetime(2023, 2, 1, 0, 0)) for i in features_data.index.get_level_values(level=1)]
  return c3.Data.from_pandas(features_data[['Mask']])
```
name: AlgorithmicallyComputedTrainingMaskTechnique
